prescribedGeometry.description: Exact C1.1 prescribed display paths formed from two all-equatorial B1.3 components with a common circulation sense; no binding or physical realization is implied.

choices: Both components use the B1.3 all-equatorial radii, zero axial half-separations, transverse orbit radii, common frequency, phases, and polarity assignments.

The braid centers at (0,0,-0.55) and (0,0,0.55) lie on the common z axis and select axial center-to-center offset d_C=1.10; identity relative orientation, equal frequencies, and relative phase pi/3 complete the representative.
The common circulation sign is the C1.1 member relation; the selected sign +1 is an illustrative orientation choice.
